scenes.label: Meet Tara
scenes.title: The Pet Finder is live!
scenes.caption: Meet Tara. Her coding club has built a Pet Finder: a camera on the corner of her lane that spots dogs and helps find lost pets. Everyone on the lane loves Kittu, a friendly brown indie dog. Tara feeds him biscuits every morning on her way to school.
scenes.dialogue: Our Pet Finder can spot any dog!

scenes.label: Kittu is missing
scenes.title: It walked right past him.
scenes.caption: Then one morning, Kittu isn't waiting for his biscuits. He's missing! Tara checks the Pet Finder. The camera saw a brown dog walk right past, but it said: not a dog. No alert was sent. Kittu was right there, and the finder didn't recognise him.
scenes.dialogue: Kittu walked right past, and it missed him!

scenes.label: Check the data
scenes.title: What did the finder learn from?
scenes.caption: Tara asks Ms Fernandes, the club teacher, for help. A model learns from examples. This set of examples is called training data. Almost every photo showed a golden retriever. So the finder learned that a dog means golden and fluffy. It had never seen a dog like Kittu.
scenes.speech: Tara asks Miss Fernandes, the club teacher, for help. A model learns from examples. This set of examples is called training data. Almost every photo showed a golden retriever. So the finder learned that a dog means golden and fluffy. It had never seen a dog like Kittu.
scenes.dialogue: It only ever saw golden retrievers?

scenes.label: Label the photos
scenes.title: Every kind of dog needs a label.
scenes.caption: Your turn. Help Tara fix the training data. Tap every photo that shows a dog to label it Dog, including dogs like Kittu. Leave the other animals unlabelled. Then retrain and test. Careful: training with only golden retrievers again won't help Kittu.
scenes.dialogue: Every kind of dog needs a label.

scenes.label: Varied data
scenes.title: Good data is varied.
scenes.caption: Now the finder spots Kittu! Good training data is varied: many breeds, sizes and colours, in different light and from different angles. Leave a group out, and the model can unfairly fail that group. Even now, the finder can make mistakes, so a person checks every alert.
scenes.dialogue: Different dogs, different light, different angles!

scenes.label: A happier ending
scenes.title: Kittu is home!
scenes.caption: An alert pings: a brown dog near the park. A club member checks the photo. It's Kittu! Tara and the neighbours bring him home, tired but safe. Tara has learned that a model only knows what its examples teach it. Your turn: help Tara build a fairer dog dataset!
scenes.dialogue: Kittu's home, and he's eating his biscuits!
